author: Bobby Grayson
description: Pre-existing: elixir elixir/bank.exs | tail -1 etc. Verified the fuzz mismatch exits 1 (System.halt(1)) and that with a pipe the shell saw 0.
title: check.sh pipes every driver through tail -1 under plain sh (no pipefail), so a driver's exit 1 is hidden by tail's 0; the fuzz line runs unpiped so its exit status propagates. The integrator may want set -o pipefail or to drop the tails for the older drivers.
